reference_sql:
SELECT a.variant, COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS n_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS n_converted,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM ab_assignments a
LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c ON c.test_id = a.test_id AND c.customer_id = a.customer_id AND c.converted_at >= a.assigned_at
WHERE a.test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
GROUP BY a.variant
ORDER BY a.variant

solver.query:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT a.variant, a.customer_id,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ab_conversions c
                           WHERE c.test_id = a.test_id AND c.customer_id = a.customer_id
                             AND c.converted_at >= a.assigned_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS conv
  FROM ab_assignments a
  WHERE a.test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
)
SELECT variant,
       COUNT(*) AS n_customers,
       SUM(conv) AS n_converted,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(conv) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM f
GROUP BY variant
ORDER BY variant
